newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France drains 1.1 bln Ffr at tender. [corrected 12:20 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Bank of France drains 1.1 bln Ffr at tender. [corrected 12:20 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline and first paragraph to read drained instead of injected)
The Bank of France drained 1.1 billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.

It accepted bids for 39.0 billion francs in new liquidity, 1.1 billion less (Corrects from more) than the 40.1 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on April 25.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.8 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.5 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 27.2 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 11.2 percent of this demand.
